verdict.rationale: The evidence covers Asana's rule actions, webhooks, the API, AI Studio no-code automations and AI Teammates, but none of it documents scheduling recurring or time-based jobs or workflows. Generic automation is not a recurring schedule. Third-party tools such as Zapier, n8n and Pipedream are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
